core.title: Give every WMBT a one-line context clarifier
core.given: A WMBT is being authored or edited
core.then: Declare a context clarifier: a detailed situational phrase, one line at most, that says when, where or how the WMBT applies. It is required.
prefer: One concrete line that names the situation the WMBT applies to (when, where or how), so the statement template can append it to the WMBT statement.
avoid: Leaving the context clarifier out or empty.
Clarifiers that span more than one line or turn into a paragraph.
Vague or generic qualifiers that do not narrow the situation.
core.why: The statement template appends the clarifier to the WMBT statement. Without a precise, situational one-line qualifier, the WMBT does not say when it applies.
evidence: Every WMBT in scope has a non-empty context clarifier entry.
The context clarifier is a single line.
A reviewer confirms the phrase is situational (when/where/how) and not generic.
verification: Scope: every WMBT plan artifact in scope. WMBT artifacts are found by file kind or path in the plan tree; the concrete artifact kinds that identify a WMBT come from the profile (roles.plan_artifact.kinds).
The context clarifier entry is required: a missing or empty entry is a finding.
The clarifier must fit on one line: a line break inside the value is a finding.
Missing/empty and multi-line are mechanically checkable; whether the phrase is detailed and situational (names when/where/how) is not mechanically decidable and is LLM-judged or reviewer-confirmed.

fires: The planner authors a new WMBT for a wagon.
The planner edits an existing WMBT's statement or context clarifier.
A WMBT has no context clarifier, or its clarifier spans more than one line.
doesNotFire: Editing acceptance test code that leaves the WMBT definition unchanged.
Editing wagon or plan docs that contain no WMBT entries.

profileRequirements.meaning: The concrete artifact kinds that play the plan-artifact role, i.e. the file kind that counts as a WMBT, so the rule and its check know their scope.

bunOnly.text: Term id: context_clarifier, defined as 'a one-line situational qualifier'.
bunOnly.reason: The term id context_clarifier is this rule's identifier in the ATDD-Bun sidecar encoding (it is also the WMBT artifact's field name, referenced again in evidence[0] and evidence[1]); ids of a single rule's validator terms are realization details, so the core speaks of the 'context clarifier' generically.

bunOnly.text: values.required = true: a missing or empty field is a finding.
bunOnly.reason: The values.required flag is the Bun validator's sidecar encoding; the neutral requirement (the clarifier is required; a missing or empty entry is a finding) is stated in core:verification.

bunOnly.text: values.pattern = 'detailed situational phrase, one line maximum': a newline inside the value is a finding. 'Detailed situational' is LLM-judged.
bunOnly.reason: The values.pattern flag is the Bun validator's sidecar encoding; the neutral checks (single line, a line break is a finding, situational quality is LLM-judged) are stated in core:verification.
These are this rule's finding ids in the Bun realization; the core keeps the activation fact with generic finding descriptions and describes the underlying checks generically in core:verification.

neutralityNotes: This rule constrains plan-artifact content, not code, so it is almost entirely neutral: given/when/then/why, prefer, avoid, evidence, fires and doesNotFire carry over unchanged apart from the field name context_clarifier, which is the ATDD-Bun sidecar's term id for the clarifier entry (also the WMBT artifact's field name) and survives only in bunOnly. 'WMBT' and 'wagon' are retained as methodology-level plan-artifact concepts (the closed vocabulary itself parametrizes urn.wmbt and layout.wagon_dir). The concrete file kind that identifies a WMBT comes from the profile (roles.plan_artifact.kinds); bun.json states only generically that WMBT artifacts are found 'by file kind or path in the plan tree' and supplies no concrete plan-item path pattern, so no layout requirement is extracted and the discovery remark stays a generic scope note in core:verification. The sidecar encodings values.required / values.pattern and this rule's finding ids have no stack-neutral equivalent and stay bunOnly; per-rule severity/disposition are not stated by bun.json, so the core's verification adds none.
